items.q: Leonard Feather one of the fellows had put in a book that Bird said that he was not influenced at all by -- by Prez

ctx.x: Yeah, well, that's the proper way to look at it, although, of course, they -- the --
I think he resented Bird more than that because Leonard Feather one of the fellows had put in a book that Bird said that he was not influenced at all by -- by Prez, you know.
